$why: THE PIPELINE'S TOOLS, ON A SET THAT ATTACHES THEM TO THE AGENT (its runner declares hostedToolPlugins).
Chosen by lib/pipeline-tools.js; the counterpart is pipeline-tools-command. No path: the tools are
attached, and their schemas say the rest (operator, 2026-10-01: relative paths only).
description: Tells an agent which pipeline tools it has, on a set that hosts them as tools.
body:
YOUR TOOLS — they are attached to you; call them directly (there are no scripts to run):
  codegraph_query — mode "explore" with terms "<domain nouns>"; mode "query", "callers" or "callees" with symbol "<SymbolName>"; mode "show" with file "<file>" and optional startLine/endLine. When more than one codeline is in scope, name the codeline.
  your search tool — find an exact symbol, or a file by part of its name, across the working tree.
  resolve_package_symbol — packageName "<package name>", symbol "<method or function name>": a third-party symbol's real declared shape and the package's documented usage.
